name: Tryon Abandoned
description: Triggered when a shopper tries something on and doesn't buy within 24 hours. Shows them wearing the product to bring them back.

body_blocks.note: Use the event's render_image_url directly — it's a signed URL that expires at event.render_expires_at (30 days). Klaviyo does not need to fetch/store it; it just embeds the URL.

body_blocks.content: You tried on {{ event.product_title }}{% if event.variant_size %} in size {{ event.variant_size }}{% endif %}{% if event.variant_color %}, {{ event.variant_color }}{% endif %}. It's still available.

notes: This is a starting-point template, not a finished flow — import it into Klaviyo's flow builder and adjust timing/copy to your brand.
The event properties available: product_title, product_url, buy_url, render_image_url, render_expires_at, variant_size, variant_color (see section 9.8 of the build spec).
Cap: this event fires at most once per shopper per merchant per 7 days, so a single-email flow (no repeat sends) is the right default.
